services.name: Restriping
services.shortDescription: Fresh, high-visibility lines that keep traffic flowing safely.
services.description: We repaint crisp, code-compliant parking stalls, fire lanes, and directional arrows using fast-drying traffic paint built to withstand heavy wear. Whether your lines have faded or you've just sealcoated, we get it done with minimal disruption to your business.
services.imageAlt: Freshly painted yellow parking stall lines beside numbered pickup signs

services.name: New Layout & ADA Striping
services.shortDescription: New parking layouts and accessible spaces built to code.
services.description: Starting from fresh asphalt or reworking an existing lot, we lay out stalls, drive aisles, and traffic flow, and paint ADA-compliant accessible spaces, access aisles, and symbols to current federal standards, helping property owners stay compliant while serving every customer.
services.imageAlt: Crew member spraying the accessible parking symbol through a stencil onto fresh asphalt

services.name: Sealcoating
services.shortDescription: Protective coating that extends the life of your pavement.
services.description: Sealcoating shields asphalt from sun, water, and chemical damage while giving your lot a fresh, uniform black finish. Regular sealcoating slows down cracking and potholes, saving you money on costly repaving down the road.
services.imageAlt: Crew member applying sealcoat to the surface of an asphalt parking lot with a spray wand

services.name: Crack Filling
services.shortDescription: Seal out water before small cracks become big repairs.
services.description: Water that seeps through asphalt cracks softens the base and turns a hairline crack into a pothole. We clean out each crack and fill it with commercial-grade sealant, keeping moisture out and stretching the life of your pavement.
services.imageAlt: Asphalt surface with sealed cracks filled with black crack sealant
features: Done before sealcoating for best results

services.name: Patching & Potholes
services.shortDescription: Fast repairs for potholes and damaged pavement.
services.description: Potholes and broken pavement are a trip hazard, a vehicle-damage risk, and a liability. We repair damaged areas so your lot is safe to use again, and so the damage doesn't keep spreading.
services.imageAlt: Crew member shoveling fresh asphalt patch material into a pothole

services.name: Residential Driveway
services.shortDescription: Protect and refresh your home's asphalt driveway.
services.description: The same care we give commercial lots, scaled for your home. We repair cracks and seal your asphalt driveway to protect it from sun, water, and winter weather and to give it a clean, fresh look.
services.imageAlt: Crew member spreading sealcoat on asphalt with a squeegee applicator

services.name: Full Package
services.shortDescription: Repair, seal, and stripe in one coordinated project.
services.description: Get the whole lot done in one visit. We repair cracks and damaged areas, sealcoat the surface, and restripe the finished pavement, so you close the lot once, deal with one crew, and end up with a property that looks brand new.
services.imageAlt: Freshly sealcoated black parking lot with new yellow stall lines
features: One crew, one schedule, one quote

services.name: Warehouse Floor Marking
services.shortDescription: Clear aisles, walkways, and safety zones for your facility floor.
services.description: We lay out and apply aisle lines, pedestrian walkways, forklift lanes, and dock and staging areas on warehouse and industrial floors. Durable coatings and tape suited to your traffic keep people and equipment moving safely, and work is phased around your operations.
services.imageAlt: Warehouse floor with yellow lane lines marked across polished concrete beside racking and loading dock doors
